# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `zoho-books` plugin, the opt-in for the Zoho Books MCP server that Cursor hosts and credentials.
- Carries no MCP server definition: the server is Cursor-side, so installing the plugin is the whole configuration.
- Auth is Cursor-managed OAuth against Zoho. The user picks their Zoho data center before signing in.
- Logo: Zoho Books' official mark, from `zoho.com`.
